local.title: Set up a local Ventilation Advisor
local.description: Give this installation a name, then select a weather provider and optionally a warning service. Rooms can be added afterwards.

data_description.display_mode: 🟢 room air good / 🔴 strong need to ventilate is the default. Alternative: 🟢 ventilate / 🔴 keep closed. Real hazards always appear separately with 🔒.

remote.title: Connect a remote Ventilation Advisor
remote.description: Remote connections are deliberately limited to Tailscale addresses. Only current Ventilation Advisor snapshots are transferred; remote sensors and their history are not created in this Home Assistant. Continue first tests the connection only; it is saved after the following success confirmation.

user.title: Add room
